investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Blocked by Swarm Agent Quota Exhaustion (HTTP 409)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-17T05:17:36Z with an identical HTTP 409 response from POST /api/agents indicating the swarm agent quota for the eval org has been exhausted at its limit of 100. Because agent creation is the first step in the eval runner (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs line 1339), no evidence was collected and all downstream contract assertions were never reached.
investigation.rootCause: The production-api swarm backend rejected POST /api/agents with a 409 conflict error whose inner message reads "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". The eval org has reached the maximum allowed number of swarm agents (100), so the createAgent call in the runner fails immediately and no agent is provisioned. Because agent creation is a prerequisite for all three remote-agents checks, every check in the feature fails with the same error and zero evidence is written, causing the full expected-output contract (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) to be unmet. This is an eval infrastructure failure caused by a resource-limit condition in the production API; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed immediately with a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error carrying a 404 status, indicating the agent runtime harness endpoint was unreachable when the runner called /api/generate/image/stream. Because the session could not be opened, the stream never emitted a generation_completed frame and no image URL was produced, causing both contract assertions to fail.
